items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I saw Bill Bojangles Robinson with a Medicine Show.

ctx.x: Now there is a gap in between that I have no recollection of, never have because I'm not sure if there is a gap. Because all I can ever remember is the next thing I knew, I was traveling and I was singing and dancing. I couldn't give you a clue how I learned to dance, other than looking at people dancing, you know? That's how I think I learned.

But years later when we were traveling on the carnivals, they had some great, great dancers -- and I remember, I saw Bill Bojangles Robinson with a Medicine Show. I don't know if you're familiar with what Medicine Shows were. Medicine Shows were things that just went around from town to town with a wagon, and they would open up there and they'd have some kind of little stage built there.
